description: The remainder of division by zero is the dividend
notes: The spec doesn't say what the remainder of division by zero is, and with no NaN value the natural reading is an error, as native/numbers/zero-divided-by-zero-is-an-error assumes for 0 / 0. hashicorp/hcl returns the dividend unchanged: Value.Modulo in cty/value_ops.go returns its receiver when the divisor is zero, although its doc comment says the result is an infinity.
